findings.evidence: Mathlib defines `Padic` at `Mathlib/NumberTheory/Padics/PadicNumbers.lean:531` and places its API in `namespace Padic` at lines 538, 671, and 829; this file instead opens `namespace TauCeti` at line 35 and then `namespace Padic` at line 52.
findings.fix: Close `namespace TauCeti` before opening `namespace Padic`, leaving only the private generic helper in `TauCeti`, and declare all three public results as `Padic.*`.
findings.issue: `toAdd_normalizedValuation_eq_valuation`, `natCard_residueField`, and `normalizedAbsoluteValue_eq_nnnorm` are declared in `TauCeti.Padic`, although they specialize the existing Mathlib type `Padic p`; this prevents the expected `Padic.*` discovery and requires renaming if upstreamed.

summary: The new public p-adic declarations are nested under `TauCeti.Padic` instead of the existing Mathlib `Padic` namespace.
